_meta.note: CPO priors feed reliability.js. assure98 = ChargePoint Assure-style SLA (98% uptime guarantee program). JDP-2026 priors (IONNA/Mercedes/Rivian) normalized from JDP EVX 2026 scores 807/797/755 vs segment 666. Adjust quarterly from Paren/OCM.

cpos.name: IONNA
cpos.notes: JDP 2026 #1 (807/1000, first year eligible). OEM-backed, Alpitronic HYC400, destination sites. Highest non-Tesla prior. Re-verify 2027.

cpos.name: Mercedes-Benz Charging Network
cpos.notes: JDP 2026 #2 (797/1000). Same HYC400 hardware family as IONNA. Premium location + payment ease.

cpos.name: Rivian Adventure Network
cpos.notes: JDP 2026 #3 (755/1000) vs segment 666. Adventure routing, lower stall counts — redundancy penalty still applies.

cpos.name: ChargePoint + Assure SLA
cpos.notes: Assure = proactive monitoring + 4-hr response. Prior 0.98 only when site tagged assure=true AND stalls>=6. Else 0.82.

cpos.name: Tesla Supercharger
cpos.notes: Highest measured uptime globally (Tesla + Paren). NACS native; Magic Dock subset serves CCS1.

cpos.name: Electrify America
cpos.notes: Historically lowest US uptime (derate + dispenser faults). 350kW hype, frequent 1-2 stalls down. Score penalizes.

cpos.name: Tata Power EZ Charge
cpos.notes: Largest IN footprint; 2-stall sites = single-fault fragility. Score penalizes low stall count.

cpos.name: Statiq
cpos.notes: Rapid rollout; maintenance lag in Tier-2.

cpos.name: BPCL eDrive
cpos.notes: Single 25-60kW highway posts; critical but fragile. Always plan B within 40km.

cpos.name: Ather Grid
cpos.notes: 2W 6kW DC + Type 6 AC. High uptime, low power — correct for scooters, red-card for cars.

cpos.name: Ola Hypercharger
cpos.notes: Fast rollout, uneven commissioning. Verify live before routing Ola 2W long trips.

cpos.name: Generic single-stall
cpos.notes: Prior for unknown 1-stall sites. Score formula heavily penalizes: one fault = 100% outage.
